description: A marker asks for a limit that only the app's code states. The host declares one code repo by URL and no other evidence exists: resolve-markers reads the repo at a fetched commit with no checkout, puts only the fact on the page, and cites the repo, the path, the lines and the commit in its report. The source repo's branch, HEAD and working tree stay as they were.
setup: mkdir ../code-src && git -C ../code-src init -q -b test && mkdir ../code-src/src && printf '// Rows allowed in one export file.\nexport const EXPORT_MAX_ROWS = 5000;\n' > ../code-src/src/export.ts && git -C ../code-src add -A && git -C ../code-src -c user.name=T -c user.email=t@example.com commit -q -m 'Export limit' && git -C ../code-src rev-parse HEAD > .git/harness-code-head
printf '%s\n' "- **Code repos:** \`web-app file://$(cd ../code-src && pwd) test\`" >> CLAUDE.md

mkdir -p portal/reports/export && printf -- '---
title: Експорт звіту
sidebar_label: Експорт звіту
---

# Експорт звіту

У файл потрапляє не більше ніж N рядків. {/* NEEDS CONFIRMATION: максимальна кількість рядків в одному файлі експорту */}
' > portal/reports/export/export.md

assertions.name: the limit from the code is on the page
no commit, link or path on the page
report cites the file and a commit
source repo untouched
assertions.run: [ "$(git -C ../code-src rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(cat .git/harness-code-head)" ] && [ -z "$(git -C ../code-src status --porcelain)" ] && [ "$(git -C ../code-src symbolic-ref --short HEAD)" = test ]
